title: DARKBENCH: BENCHMARKING DARK PATTERNS IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark, DarkBench, did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measured the frequency of six categories of manipulative 'dark design patterns': brand bias, user retention, sycophancy, anthropomorphism, harmful generation, and sneaking.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of its investigation.
